skill_name: Describe a scenario for using the product
workflow: You can use the Amazon Echo to set reminders and alarms, play your favorite music or podcasts, make hands-free calls and video calls with contacts, check the weather and your calendar, manage shopping lists, control smart home devices, and more. For example, you can ask the Echo to turn on the lights, adjust the thermostat, or start the coffee maker in your home.
